newsitem.title: GERMANY: SCHENKER WINS US AUTO FORWARDING CONTRACTS.
newsitem.headline: SCHENKER WINS US AUTO FORWARDING CONTRACTS.

text.p: Freight forwarder Schenker International AG has won two major U.S. automobile industry contracts, the company's in-house newspaper said.
Schenker USA is to handle all forwarding for Thailand for leading automotive supplier Lear Corp, the publication said.
Lear, whose products are manufactured in more than 140 facilities in 22 countries, had global sales of 6.2 billion dollars in 1996, it added.

Robert Denning, Lear's director of global transportation, was quoted as saying: "Schenker has a worldwide capability and their services match our operational requirements. We have a high degree of confidence in them."
Schenker USA has also been selected to handle U.S. customs brokerage for the ocean imports of car manufacturer Subaru of America Inc.

Subaru manager of national traffic, George Marinaccio, said: "Previously we were working with several different brokers and we decided it would be better to consolidate all the business with one strong broker with an international organisation."
No value or volume details were given for either contract.
